```artifact
## Decision Table Test Suite for Doorstop

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| Requirement ID | REQ003 | Generate unique and permanent identifiers for linkable sections of text. |
| Requirement ID | REQ004 | Support formatting within linkable text. |
| Requirement ID | REQ001 | Store external requirements assets. |
| Requirement ID | REQ016 | Import content from other requirements management tools. |
| Requirement ID | REQ017 | Export content to interact with common text/document tools. |
| Requirement ID | REQ007 | View requirements as a document. |
| Requirement ID | REQ008 | View document items interactively. |
| Requirement ID | REQ009 | Baseline versions of requirements. |
| Input | Text to link | Generate unique identifier. |
| Input | Formatting code | Apply formatting. |
| Input | External requirements asset | Store asset. |
| Input | Content from other tool | Import content. |
| Input | Text/document tool | Export content. |
| Input | Requirement version | Baseline version. |
| Expected Result | Unique identifier generated |
| Expected Result | Formatting applied |
| Expected Result | External requirements asset stored |
| Expected Result | Content imported |
| Expected Result | Content exported |
| Expected Result | Requirement version baselineed |

```
